An explicit owner/session/record input change invalidates retained local resource/draft state; preserving it would leak the previous owner. UiCodeTemplateStudio initializes independent unsaved draft and preview from the explicit studio initialValue. Parent CodeTemplatesTab creates that stable snapshot for opening an editor and destroys the studio on close; reset on open/snapshot change prevents another template inheriting draft state. Reassessed 2026-11-03: The studio derives save access from template create/update operation and independently disables execution. Template identity and revision still delimit editable source and retained preview resources.

Route tests retain failure/retry, readonly access, search, editing and pending-write behavior. NavigationMoveTree still owns drag projection and editor owns page/tab sessions.

SettingsSectionSurface.status and toolbar are explicitly typed ReactNode and rendered directly in named layout regions. loadError is the intended Alert/retry content for the status slot, with its retry button bound to the current query. It is an element tree, not a render-local component type or an effect resource identity. The table retains cached templates during failed background refresh and is withheld for a first failed request; UI-management template tests assert failure versus empty data, retry recovery and retained cached rows. Reassessed 2026-11-03 against the receiver and actual call site.
